cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her family can walk through walls. They tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.

mechanism: A copies empty names as planning for invisible companions and escalates accommodations to cover the mistaken confident booking.
confusable: D163 answers strange offers with justified additions; D145 treats strangeness as ordinary without escalation.
comparison: Commercial airborne service versus generous wedding hospitality.
seedUse: Retain B wandering guests and splitting ballroom as the actual causes of A accommodations.
